summary: Learn AutoCAD drafting, drawing layouts and introductory 3D CAD through practical file-based exercises. Explore the course and review the outline.
lede: 3D CAD training helps drafters, designers and technical staff create and revise structured drawings and introductory solid models in AutoCAD. You’ll practise setting up geometry, organizing layers and dimensions, arranging paper-space layouts, and building solids with extrusion and Boolean operations. The course also covers model views and rendering, plus quality checks and file handover for editable drawing deliverables.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who create, check or coordinate AutoCAD drawings and need practical 2D drafting skills alongside an introduction to 3D CAD workflows.
prerequisites: Basic computer skills are expected. No prior 3D CAD experience or programming is required. For hands-on AutoCAD exercises, bring a laptop with AutoCAD installed and access to a suitable licence.
